edits.old_string: -- ONCE per player (saved PlayerData.FreeGift). A game can't see likes, so the like step is on trust.
edits.new_string:
-- ONCE per player (saved PlayerData.FreeGift). (2026-10-22 owner) The like is a friendly ask only: never checked, never
-- required. The reward needs the group. FreeGift.InGroup() lets the window show the SAME check the claim runs.
-- Studio only: player attribute FreeGiftTestNotInGroup = true makes inGroup() answer false (tests).

edits.old_string:
local function inGroup(player)
	local ok, groups = pcall(GroupService.GetGroupsAsync, GroupService, player.UserId)
edits.new_string:
local function inGroup(player)
	if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() and player:GetAttribute("FreeGiftTestNotInGroup") == true then return false end
	local ok, groups = pcall(GroupService.GetGroupsAsync, GroupService, player.UserId)

-- the window's group state = the claim's own check (1 call per 2 s per player; a faster call gets the last answer)
local InGroup = folder:FindFirstChild("InGroup") or Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
InGroup.Name = "InGroup"
InGroup.Parent = folder
local lastCheck, lastAnswer = {}, {}
InGroup.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCheck[player] and now - lastCheck[player] < 2 and lastAnswer[player] ~= nil then return lastAnswer[player] end
	lastCheck[player] = now
	lastAnswer[player] = inGroup(player)
	return lastAnswer[player]
end

local busy, last = {}, {}
Claim.OnServerInvoke = function(player)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	busy[p], last[p] = nil, nil
	lastCheck[p], lastAnswer[p] = nil, nil
end)
